The generosity of Iraqis is known to everyone.
Volunteering gives a person a sense of meaning.
The trees blossom in the spring season.
The birds fly high above the sea.
A colorful butterfly landed on the flower.

arabic: كَمْ مِنَ الوَقْتِ تَعْمَلُ في هَذِهِ الشَّرِكَةِ؟
english: How long have you been working at this company?

arabic: فَريقُنا يَجْتَمِعُ كُلَّ صَباحٍ لِخَمْسِ دَقائِقَ.
english: Our team meets every morning for five minutes.
We put forward many ideas in the meeting.

arabic: أَعْتَقِدُ أَنَّكَ عَلى حَقٍّ في هَذِهِ المَسْأَلَةِ.
english: I think you are right on this matter.

arabic: عِنْدي سُؤالٌ واحِدٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ نَبْدَأَ.
english: I have one question before we begin.

arabic: أَقَمْنا في مُخَيَّمٍ صَحْراوِيٍّ لَيْلَةً واحِدَةً.
english: We stayed in a desert camp for one night.

arabic: نِمْنا في خَيْمَةٍ عادِيَّةٍ تَحْتَ النُّجومِ.
english: We slept in a regular tent under the stars.
I love the smell of soil after rain.

arabic: جَلَساتُ العائِلَةِ المَسائِيَّةُ هِيَ أَجْمَلُ الأَوْقاتِ.
english: The family's evening gatherings are the best of times.
We watched a scary film last night.

arabic: كانَتْ جَدَّتي، رَحِمَها اللهُ، تَرْتَدي عَباءَةً سَوْداءَ دائِمًا.
english: My grandmother (peace be upon her) wore a black abaya all the time.
She was a very strong woman.

arabic: اشْتَرى ثَوْبًا تَقْليدِيًّا مِنَ السّوقِ القَديمِ.
english: He bought a traditional garment from the old market.

arabic: طَريقَةُ العَيْشِ في القَرْيَةِ بَسيطَةٌ وَهادِئَةٌ.
english: The way of living in the village is simple and quiet.

arabic: نَزورُ مَزْرَعَةَ جَدّي في كُلِّ صَيْفٍ.
english: We visit my grandfather's farm every summer.

arabic: الوَضْعُ الآنَ أَفْضَلُ مِمّا كانَ قَبْلَ سَنَةٍ.
english: The situation now is better than it was a year ago.
We have three options to solve the problem.
We move the clock forward for daylight saving time.

arabic: يَبْدَأُ التَّوْقيتُ الشِّتَوِيُّ في نِهايَةِ تِشْرينَ الأَوَّلِ.
english: Standard time begins at the end of October.
Do you feel the spring season?
You (female) sent me

arabic: نَحْنُ مُخْتَلِفانِ في الرَّأْيِ لَكِنَّنا صَديقانِ.
english: We are different in opinion but we are friends.
I prefer to book and plan in advance.
I'm planning a long trip to Asia.

arabic: أُحِبُّ السَّفَرَ العَفْوِيَّ دونَ خَطَّةٍ مُسْبَقَةٍ.
english: I love spontaneous travel without a prior plan.

arabic: أَنا مُتَّفِقٌ مَعَكَ تَمامًا في هَذِهِ النُّقْطَةِ.
english: I completely agree with you on this point.
The matter is more complicated than it seems.

arabic: سَنُسافِرُ إِلى مِصْرَ قَريبًا إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
english: We will travel to Egypt soon, God willing.
Out of work

arabic: لو سَمَحْت، أنا عايِز مَيّة باردة.

Like / Similar to

arabic: مَصْر هِيَّ أُمّ الدُّنْيا زَيّ ما بِيْقولوا.
english: Egypt is the mother of the world, as they say.
Yes

Where?

Fresh falafel is tastier than the ready-made.

arabic: اعْتَذَرْتُ عَنِ الحُضورِ بِسَبَبِ ضيقِ الوَقْتِ.
english: I apologized for not attending because of time pressure.

arabic: طَلَبَ الطَّبيبُ مِنّي تَحْليلَ دَمٍ شامِلًا.
english: The doctor asked me for a comprehensive blood test.
The news was a big shock to the family.
The doctor advised me to reduce coffee in the evening.

arabic: أُضيفُ الزَّنْجَبيلَ إِلى الشّايِ في الشِّتاءِ.
english: I add ginger to the tea in winter.
Chicken liver and spinach
Walking has many benefits for the heart.
How do you cook this delicious dish?

arabic: أَضَعُ قَليلًا مِنَ الخَلِّ عَلى السَّلَطَةِ.
english: I put a little vinegar on the salad.
Contains iron
The dish consists of rice and lentils.
Egyptians are known for their love of jokes.
Slow down a little, the road is slippery today.

arabic: نَشْتَري الطَّعْمِيَّةَ مِنَ المَحَلِّ القَريبِ صَباحًا.
english: We buy falafel from the nearby shop in the morning.
The small boat sailed toward the island.
Koshari is a popular and cheap Egyptian dish.
My wife ate fava beans at lunch.

arabic: المانْجا المِصْرِيَّةُ حُلْوَةٌ جِدًّا في الصَّيْفِ.
english: Egyptian mango is very sweet in summer.
I tried guava in Egypt.
Hibiscus tea is a calming drink.

arabic: نُفْطِرُ عَلى التَّمْرِ وَالماءِ في رَمَضانَ.
english: We break our fast with dates and water in Ramadan.

arabic: بابا غَنّوج يُؤْكَلُ مَعَ الخُبْزِ السّاخِنِ.
english: Baba ghanoush is eaten with hot bread.

arabic: التَّبّولَةُ سَلَطَةٌ خَفيفَةٌ مِنَ البَقْدونِسِ وَالبُرْغُلِ.
english: Tabbouleh is a light salad of parsley and bulgur.

arabic: الفَتّوشُ يَحْتوي عَلى خُبْزٍ مُحَمَّصٍ وَخُضارٍ.
english: Fattoush contains toasted bread and vegetables.
I married a wonderful woman.

arabic: يَحْتَفِلُ المَسيحِيّونَ بِعيدِ الميلادِ في كانونَ الأَوَّلِ.
english: Christians celebrate Christmas in December.

arabic: وُلِدَ المَسيحُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلامُ في بَيْتَ لَحْمَ.
english: Christ, peace be upon him, was born in Bethlehem.
A blessed Eid to you and your family.

arabic: صَلّى المُسْلِمونَ صَلاةَ العيدِ في السّاحَةِ.
english: The Muslims prayed the Eid prayer in the square.
He put the book on the table and left.

arabic: سافَرْنا بَرًّا مِنْ عَمّانَ إِلى دِمَشْقَ.
english: We traveled by land from Amman to Damascus.

arabic: حَضَرْنا عُرْسًا كَبيرًا في القَرْيَةِ أَمْسِ.
english: We attended a big wedding in the village yesterday.

arabic: قَرَأْتُ مَقالًا مُثيرًا لِلاهْتِمامِ عَنِ التّاريخِ.
english: I read an interesting article about history.
It's complicated for me to talk about

arabic: مُسْتَوايَ في العَرَبِيَّةِ يَتَحَسَّنُ شَيْئًا فَشَيْئًا.
english: My level in Arabic is improving little by little.
For this reason I got to know him
Common things to talk about

arabic: النّاسُ لا يَتَوَقَّعونَ أَنّي أَتَكَلَّمُ العَرَبِيَّةَ.
english: People don't expect that I speak Arabic.
I answered him honestly about all his questions.

arabic: الأَهَمُّ أَنْ نَبْقى أَصْحابًا مَهْما حَدَثَ.
english: The most important thing is to stay friends no matter what.
Daily reading widens a person's knowledge.

arabic: سافَرَ في الدَّرَجَةِ الأولى لِأَوَّلِ مَرَّةٍ.
english: He traveled in first class for the first time.
A second-class ticket is much cheaper.
I noticed a clear improvement in your language.
The teacher gave me useful advice for studying.
I am at home as usual
The weather is sunny and warm, let's go out for a walk.

arabic: نَتَناوَلُ العَشاءَ مَعًا كُلَّ لَيْلَةِ جُمُعَةٍ.
english: We have dinner together every Friday night.
I leave at nine o'clock.

arabic: يَلْعَبُ الأَطْفالُ بِطائِرَةٍ وَرَقِيَّةٍ عَلى الشّاطِئِ.
english: The children play with a paper kite on the beach.

arabic: كانَتِ اللُّعْبَةُ مُمْتِعَةً وَمُثيرَةً حَتّى النِّهايَةِ.
english: The game was fun and exciting until the end.

arabic: أَشْعُرُ بِضَغْطٍ كَبيرٍ في العَمَلِ هَذا الشَّهْرَ.
english: I feel a lot of pressure at work this month.
You have a lot of lessons

arabic: شَعَرْتُ بِالإِرْهاقِ بَعْدَ يَوْمِ عَمَلٍ طَويلٍ.
english: I felt exhausted after a long workday.
Exhausted (m/f)

arabic: الاسْتِمْرارِيَّةُ أَهَمُّ مِنَ السُّرْعَةِ في التَّعَلُّمِ.
english: Continuity is more important than speed in learning.

arabic: التَّدْريسُ مِهْنَةٌ تَحْتاجُ إِلى صَبْرٍ كَبيرٍ.
english: Teaching is a profession that needs great patience.

arabic: المَوْضوعُ مُعَقَّدٌ وَيَحْتاجُ إِلى وَقْتٍ لِفَهْمِهِ.
english: The topic is complicated and needs time to understand.
We visited my wife's father
Fifty kilometers

arabic: المَطارُ يَبْعُدُ ساعَةً بِالسَّيّارَةِ عَنِ البَيْتِ.
english: The airport is an hour by car from home.

arabic: تَحَسَّنَتْ صِحَّةُ أُمّي كَثيرًا بَعْدَ العَمَلِيَّةِ.
english: My mother's health improved a lot after the operation.
With regular exercise you will become stronger.
We walk in the park every evening.

arabic: يَلْعَبُ الأَطْفالُ في الحَديقَةِ العامَّةِ بَعْدَ المَدْرَسَةِ.
english: The children play in the public garden after school.

arabic: شَعَرْتُ بِضَعْفٍ بَعْدَ أَيّامٍ مِنَ المَرَضِ.
english: I felt weak after days of illness.

arabic: كانَتْ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ يَزورُ الحَديقَةَ مُنْذُ شَهْرَيْنِ
english: It was the first time he visited the park in two months

arabic: قُمْنا بِزِيارَةِ لَهْوٍ إِلى المَدينَةِ القَديمَةِ.
english: We made a leisure visit to the old city.

arabic: أَنا شَخْصٌ هادِئٌ لا أُحِبُّ الضَّجيجَ.
english: I am a calm person who dislikes noise.
I don't talk much.

arabic: كِلاهُما يُشاهِدانِ المُبارَياتِ مَعًا كُلَّ سَبْتٍ.
english: Both of them watch the matches together every Saturday.
Tomorrow is an official holiday for the Eid.

arabic: لا أَرْتَدي مَلابِسَ رَسْمِيَّةً حَتّى في الاجْتِماعاتِ المُهِمَّةِ.
english: I don't even wear formal clothes in important meetings.

arabic: لا أُحِبُّ الحَديثَ في السِّياسَةِ مَعَ الغُرَباءِ.
english: I don't like talking politics with strangers.

arabic: أَتَوَقَّفُ عَنِ العَمَلِ في السّاعَةِ الخامِسَةِ مَساءً.
english: I stop working at five in the evening.
I take a break from work
I sit in nature to rest my mind.

arabic: الحَياةُ الرِّيفِيَّةُ أَهْدَأُ مِنْ حَياةِ المُدُنِ.
english: Rural life is calmer than city life.
The waves are high today, so swimming is dangerous.

arabic: نَرى قُوَّةَ الخالِقِ في جَمالِ الطَّبيعَةِ.
english: We see the power of the Creator in the beauty of nature.
Because I'm here

The shops here stay open until late at night.

arabic: أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
english: The most beloved deeds to Allah are those done consistently, even if small

english: I was born in England and live here, and my father is from Iraq

english: Quick speech is easy — you say what you want; but writing is harder

arabic: مُنْذُ الطُّفولَةِ سَمِعْتُ صَوْتَ اللُّغَةِ مِنْ والِدي وَمِنَ الرّاديو
english: Since childhood I heard the sound of the language from my father and the radio

arabic: كانَ والِدي يَسْتَمِعُ إِلى الأَغاني التَّقْليدِيَّةِ وَيُشاهِدُ التِّلْفازَ العَرَبِيَّ
english: My father used to listen to traditional songs and watch Arabic television

arabic: وَمَرَّةً أَعْطاني الهاتِفَ فَسَمِعْتُ جَدَّتي وَلَمْ أَفْهَمْ شَيْئاً
english: Once he handed me the phone and I heard my grandmother but understood nothing

arabic: كُنْتُ أُريدُ أَنْ أَتَحَدَّثَ مَعَ جَدَّتي وَأَنْ أَفْهَمَ هٰذِهِ اللُّغَةَ
english: I wanted to talk with my grandmother and understand this language

arabic: كَبِرْتُ في مَدينَةٍ صَغيرَةٍ تَقْليدِيَّةٍ لَيْسَ فيها أَشْخاصٌ عَرَبٌ
english: I grew up in a small, traditional town with no Arab people

arabic: وَلَمْ نَكُنْ نَتَحَدَّثُ العَرَبِيَّةَ في المَنْزِلِ بِسَبَبِ والِدَتي
english: We didn't speak Arabic at home because of my mother

arabic: كانَ هُناكَ نَقْصٌ في الفَهْمِ حَقّاً
english: There was truly a lack of understanding

english: I had curiosity about the culture, religion, and life in Arab countries

arabic: كانَ لَدَيَّ أَسْئِلَةٌ كَثيرَةٌ سَأَلْتُها لِوالِدي

arabic: وَحينَ جِئْتُ كانَ عَلَيَّ أَنْ أَنْدَمِجَ في المُجْتَمَعِ وَأَنْ أَعيشَ حَياةً بِريطانِيَّةً
